title: QNu Labs Introduces Corporate Quantum-Safe Training Supported by National Quantum Mission - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Bengaluru-based quantum cybersecurity firm QNu Labs has launched a specialized corporate training curriculum under its educational arm, QNu Academy, aimed at preparing enterprise security practitioners for quantum-safe migration. Endorsed and supported by the Government of India’s National Quantum Mission (NQM), the 12-hour program is designed for Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), network architects, and risk officers to assess enterprise cryptographic vulnerabilities and plan transitions against emerging quantum threats, including “harvest now, decrypt later” (HNDL) data exposure.

Delivered over three days, the curriculum covers foundational and operational components of quantum communications and post-quantum transitions, including Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), Quantum Random Number Generation (QRNG), Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), cryptographic asset inventory management, and algorithm selection frameworks. The courses incorporate field data and architectural case studies drawn from QNu Labs’ operational deployments across Indian defense networks and national banking infrastructure. Instruction will be co-led by QNu Labs deployment engineers alongside faculty from Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs), National Institutes of Technology (NITs), and Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research (IISERs), with participants completing an assessment-based certification recognized under the NQM.

The enterprise training rollout complements QNu Labs’ commercial channel strategy, including its recent distribution partnership with Netpoleon India to expand enterprise deployment of its QShield 2.0 crypto-agility and risk profiling platform across banking, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure sectors. The corporate program is offered as on-site intensive workshops for cohorts of 15 to 50 professionals, alongside half-day executive briefings tailored for corporate boards and senior management teams.

Program outlines and corporate enrollment details are available via the CIO Influence Coverage here. Readers can also review related QCR coverage of QNu Labs’ educational and platform roadmaps in QNu Labs Launches QNu Academy to Train Workforce for India’s National Quantum Mission here and QNu Labs Launches QShield 2.0 to Drive India’s National Cryptographic Assessment & Assurance Framework here.
